meetingPattern.text: Regular City Commission meetings about once a month, usually a Wednesday at 8:30 a.m., in the Commission Chamber, Miami Beach City Hall, 1700 Convention Center Drive, 3rd floor. Meetings are hybrid (in person plus Zoom webinar 81392857671). Separate Presentations and Awards meetings at 5:00 p.m. about six times a year. The Commission is in recess in August. The two budget hearings are in September at 5:01 p.m. Agendas are on the PrimeGov portal (not Granicus); the clerk also posts weekly ADA meeting notices and a yearly meeting-dates page. Commission committees (Finance and Economic Resiliency; Land Use and Sustainability; Public Safety and Neighborhood Quality of Life) meet monthly, also hybrid.

public-comment.deadline: Be present at 8:30 a.m. or 1:00 p.m. on meeting day

written-comment.deadline: 5:00 p.m. the day before the meeting

petition.deadline: No collection time limit is stated in Article VII; 30 days to cure an insufficient petition

referendum.deadline: No collection time limit stated; 30 days to cure an insufficient petition

recall.deadline: 30 days for the first round of signatures; 60 days for the second

qualify.deadline: Petition in lieu of fee by noon 14 days before qualifying; qualifying closes Sept 10, 2027

vote.deadline: Register by Oct 4, 2027 for the general election
